description: Spec §8.2: after RestartRace the player's next gate (1) glows (its pylons' and banner's Gate MIDs at Glow 4) and the other gates are dim (0.6). Passing gate 1 (NotifyCheckpointReached, which advances the gate through NotifyCheckpointPassed) lights gate 2 and dims gate 1; passing 2 and 3 lights the start line (0); crossing it (a lap) lights gate 1 again.
